cProfile of one tla_trophies_floor render (etude 0.4.x from PyPI, 888 s wall under cProfile, concurrent with another render; peak RSS 3.6 GB; 22 MB HTML). Cumulative times:
- Training charts, train/report.py:362 training(): 412 s. read.py chart() 14,322 calls -> manifest.array 1,168,440 calls -> storage.get_range -> cache._read_range 1.17M calls (336 s), cache._slice 258 s, cache._checked 2.35M calls (223 s), pathlib open 3.56M calls (124 s). Every point is a separate cached range read that reopens and re-checks a file; read.py _stretch_points/_clock/_place (248/221/146 s) and report.py _band 2,280 calls (257 s), _trace (136 s).
- Eval stats: eval/query.py:203 _schema 2 calls, 318 s self time (one DuckDB statement); query.py:415 _training_checkpoints and :409 _kind, 182 s self time in one call.
- R2: 1,125 serial S3 requests, 191 s (~0.17 s each); storage.get 8,586 calls (163 s).
Likely wins to measure: read each manifest array once per run (not per point/range), batch or parallelize R2 fetches and skip sealed blocks already cached, make the _schema/_kind/_training_checkpoints DuckDB queries incremental or indexed, and keep the statsdb write lock to the ingest step only.
